comments.author: @RATheBlueWolf2021
comments.text: Jesus, my life, my source of gratitude, is the sycamore tree that I must climb. Thank You for everything; God is already at work. In Your name, I pray. Amen.

comments.author: @pamyvilla
comments.text:
Instead of answering the question for today, I wan to share my takeaway from today’s FULL TANK.

“Do what you can do TODAY and trust God with your tomorrow”

That line is the bullseye of my current situation financially. That is God right there speaking to me thru you Brother Bo.

May I add the past. It’s also a gift for me because that’s the lesson I will bring to my TODAY. It is the one guiding me to do what is right today so that Gor can do His work better for my tomorrow.

So as I set out TODAY, I invite the Holy Spirit to he in me to be wise to learn the lessons from the past, be humble enough to accept it, to be courageous enough to do all the best that I can and be faithful enough to God to trust Him.

Let’s do this 💪

AMEN 🙏

comments.author: @randyvidal1057
comments.text:
Lord Jesus Christ, come and stay with us. Fill our lives with your peace, our home with your presence, and our hearts with your praise. Help us to show kindness, mercy, and goodness to all, even to those who cause us ill-will or harm. Amen. To have faith is to be sure of the things we hope for, to be certain of the things we cannot see. Hebrews 11:1, TEV

Lord our God, we come to you in community of faith and trust, in expectation that you will act. May our hearts be strengthened in all the pain and in all the conflicts of our world. Reveal your will, Almighty God, and protect those you have appointed as our leaders and rulers. Let your will be made plain to them. O Lord God, help your people in these times and give them strength to wait expectantly for what is good, to live and serve in this expectation. Grant your help to all who strive for this. We can all tell of the help that comes from you, for you always support us with your power, also in hard times. In Jesus Christ Name. Amen.
